Learn about Jury Nullification (The Government Would Prefer You Didnt)

Jury nullification is a very old principle inherited from British Common Law. It applies not just in the USA and Britain but in most other nations of the British Commonwealth as well. Lawyers can't/won't raise it in court because they can expect severe repercussions. Ordinary people can raise it during questioning in jury selection. If you do you will almost certainly not get chosen for duty. More likely than not the entire room of potential jurors who might hear you will be dismissed as well. You won't be popular. Make sure to memorize the names of the judge and counsel. It might come in useful.
